units.title: Unit 1: Basics of Python
units.summary: Print statements, operators, and data types — the building blocks every Python program starts from.
concepts: Data types and the rules around them
Combining data types in a print statement

projects.title: Digital Business Card
projects.description: Print a personal digital business card — name, age, school, hobby, contact info — in a clean, organized layout using print statements, variables, and formatting.

projects.title: Game Character Profile
projects.description: Display a video game character's stats (health, attack, defense, inventory value) using variables and calculations, formatted like an in-game profile screen.

projects.title: Restaurant Receipt Generator
projects.description: Print a realistic restaurant receipt showing menu items, prices, subtotal, tax, and final total — built with operators.

units.title: Unit 2: Strings and Input
units.summary: Taking input from the user and going deep on strings — concatenation, slicing, indexing, and string methods.
concepts: Strings in depth: concatenation, slicing, indexing, escape characters
Boolean-returning string functions (upper, lower, isdigit, and more)

projects.title: Interactive Profile Creator
projects.description: The Unit 1 business card project, but interactive — ask the user for their info with input() and display it as a formatted profile card. Include decorators.

projects.title: Movie Ticket Generator
projects.description: Collect a customer's name, movie choice, seat, and number of tickets, then print a professional-looking movie ticket with the total price (movie list and prices provided). Decorators optional.

projects.title: Social Media Sign-Up Analyzer
projects.description: Collect a username, password, and bio, then display a profile that also analyzes the username — its length, an uppercase version, and a lowercase version — using string methods and booleans.

units.title: Unit 3: Data Collections
units.summary: Lists, tuples, dictionaries, and sets — organizing and nesting real data, plus the random and math modules.
concepts: Each data collection type in depth (lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets)
Useful functions (range, upper, lower, isdigit, and more)

projects.title: Digital Vacation Planner
projects.description: Store an upcoming trip's details — destinations, packing list, travel dates, traveler info — across different data collection types, then display it all as a clean travel itinerary.

projects.title: Grocery Store Checkout
projects.description: Build a menu or store with items stored in a dictionary (item: price). Let the user add items to a cart list, then print a receipt with subtotal, 5% tax, and total.

units.title: Unit 4: Loops & Conditionals
units.summary: For loops, while loops, nesting, and if/elif/else — the logic that lets programs make decisions and repeat themselves.

projects.title: Number Guessing Game
projects.description: A 1-player or 2-player game with at least 3 difficulty levels, each with its own number range and guess limit. The program picks a random number and tells the player higher/lower after each guess.

projects.title: Roulette / Russian Roulette
projects.description: Two variants: a roulette gambling game where the player bets on a color or number against a random spin (35x payout on a number, 2x on a color), or a multiplayer Russian Roulette where each player picks a slot and a random draw eliminates one per round.

projects.title: Rock Paper Scissors
projects.description: A rock-paper-scissors game supporting both 2-player and player-vs-computer modes.

projects.title: Restaurant Receipt Generator (v2)
projects.description: The Unit 1 receipt project again, but now interactive — take menu items via input and use loops over lists to build and print the receipt.

units.title: Unit 5: Functions
units.summary: Built-in and custom functions — how to break a program into reusable, well-named pieces.
concepts: Useful built-in functions (range, upper, lower, isdigit, and more)

projects.title: Trivia Game with Team Scoring
projects.description: Randomly pull questions from a pool and take answers via input. Track points per team and question type, then display a winner, the top 3, and full team placements.

projects.title: Movie Average Rating Calculator
projects.description: Calculate and display the average rating for a movie from a set of individual ratings.

units.title: Unit 6: Object-Oriented Programming
units.summary: Classes, methods, attributes, inheritance, and static variables — modeling real things as objects in code.

projects.title: Dungeons & Dragons Boss Fight
projects.description: A turn-based boss fight using dice rolls: the player chooses attacks and rolls a d20 each turn (1-4 miss, 5-13 hit, 14-17 crit, 18-20 a 1.5x crit) while the boss fights back with its own random, dice-rolled attacks. Includes a one-time-use attack that deals the most damage.

projects.title: Battleship vs Computer
projects.description: A Battleship game where both the player and computer get randomly placed ships, and the player must sink all computer ships before theirs are sunk.
